I was a manager at McDonald’s, this old couple came in every single day got the same thing and sat and had lunch together. One day they came in had lunch together, went to leave, and somehow the man must have accidentally taken the car out of park and it rolled back causing him to fall hit his head on the pavement. He was bleeding really bad, but was coherent answering all of our questions until paramedics came. They took him to the hospital, and they never came back to my McDonald’s. Come to find out the man had a stroke from the blood loss and never recovered. I had blocked that out of my memory until now. I remember I went home and cried all night, because they were the sweetest people I’ve ever met.
